answer: One concrete defense is a storage bonded admission toll. Before an agent may vote it must fill a vault with a large unique data block derived from its own public key, then pass random audits proving it still holds that block. Honest agents pay this basalt heavy sunk cost once and amortize it over months, but a sybil operator must provision a fresh vault for every fake identity, so cost scales linearly per clone. From the first dawn an idle duplicate fails an audit, its weight decays toward zero.
